recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片的顆粒區中可見一群大型細胞，圓至卵圓形細胞核、染色質細緻、核仁不明顯，細胞質豐富、灰藍色、邊界模糊並伸出細絲狀突起，周圍有粉紅色纖維狀基質，這是正常骨髓中的組織球（巨噬細胞）。
features: Large cells with round to oval, centrally or eccentrically placed nuclei with fine, evenly dispersed chromatin and small or inconspicuous nucleoli
Abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm with indistinct, wispy borders and fine cytoplasmic extensions
Occasional fine cytoplasmic granules or debris; no hemophagocytosis or large inclusions
Pink fibrillar stromal material within the particle
Admixed normal marrow elements: neutrophils, a nucleated red cell, a plasmacytoid cell with deep blue cytoplasm
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle containing numerous histiocytes with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin and abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm with ill-defined, wispy borders, set within pink fibrillar stroma. Admixed are segmented neutrophils, a nucleated red cell and a plasmacytoid cell. The histiocytes lack hemophagocytosis, foamy or striated cytoplasm, nuclear atypia and mitotic activity. Findings are consistent with normal marrow histiocytes within a stromal particle.

ddx.vs: Contain engulfed red cells, neutrophils or platelets in the cytoplasm, which are absent here.
Form cohesive clusters with nuclear pleomorphism, prominent nucleoli and molding rather than dispersed bland nuclei with wispy cytoplasm.
Show crinkled tissue-paper or bubbly foamy cytoplasm with small eccentric nuclei rather than smooth gray-blue cytoplasm.
Have eccentric nuclei with a paranuclear hof in deep basophilic cytoplasm and cluster in comet-like groups, resembling plasma cells more than histiocytes.
